note: Cities on the globe. status: live (built and in web/data/<id>) or planned. Planned entries list the open data to check first; none of them has been verified for this project yet.

cities.name: Sydney
cities.summary: Central Sydney: 7,962 buildings, the Opera House and Harbour Bridge, sun access on protected public places, and a game: walk it, ride the ferries, fly under the bridge.

cities.name: Whitsundays
cities.summary: The Whitsunday Islands and the inner Great Barrier Reef: 30 m survey bathymetry, a Sentinel-2 sea floor, caustics, wet sand and a swash line. Walk Whitehaven Beach, snorkel, dive.
cities.tagline: Whitehaven Beach, Hill Inlet and the Whitsunday Passage

cities.name: Hardy Reef
cities.tagline: Heart Reef and the Reefworld pontoon, outer reef
cities.summary: Hardy Reef on the outer Great Barrier Reef: Heart Reef, the Reefworld pontoon on the channel wall, and Hook, Line and Bait reefs, from 30 m survey bathymetry and Sentinel-2. No land: start on the pontoon's deck and dive the wall.

cities.name: Green Island
cities.tagline: Coral cay off Cairns, with Arlington Reef and Michaelmas Cay
cities.summary: Green Island, a coral cay 27 km off Cairns, with Arlington Reef, Upolu Cay and Michaelmas Cay: survey bathymetry, a seam-free Sentinel-2 sea floor and MSQ's tide. Walk the beach by the jetty, snorkel the reef flat.

cities.name: Heron Island
cities.tagline: Coral cay on the Tropic of Capricorn, with Wistari Reef
cities.summary: Heron Island and Heron and Wistari reefs in the southern Great Barrier Reef: the cay rebuilt from its mapped outline, the reef flat drying at low tide, the research station and the wreck of HMCS Protector at the channel.

cities.name: Lady Elliot Island
cities.tagline: The southernmost coral cay of the reef
cities.summary: Lady Elliot Island, the southernmost coral cay of the Great Barrier Reef: its platform reef in open water, the airstrip and old lighthouse, from survey bathymetry and Sentinel-2. Start on the western beach.
